Within the intricate combinatorial framework of the Paṭṭhāna, the section applies conditional relation analysis (*paccaya*) across the intersection of the thought-conception triad (*vitakkattika*) and the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
